scope: Bounded follow-up for Cook County retention judges Daniel Edward Maloney and John G. Mulroe
result: No additional attributable judicial ruling verified. Preserve the existing research gaps.
method: Consulted batch 3 owner and existing exact-name index caches before assessing candidate hits.
Checked full-text surname contexts in official court PDFs, separating trial judges from prosecutors, legislative speakers, parties, witnesses and cited precedent.
Searched official court websites, judge assignment pages, and web-indexed signed-order or news leads. Judge assignments and program announcements were not promoted to case rulings.
No contact with court personnel, access to restricted records, or production-data modification occurred.

profiles.name: Daniel Edward Maloney

officialIndexSearches.result: People v. Wade identifies Daniel Maloney as an assistant state's attorney, not the trial judge.

officialIndexSearches.followupReview: Research helper read surname-context passages in 43 official PDFs filed since 2019: 16 First District/Supreme Court criminal decisions and 27 noncriminal decisions. None established a trial ruling by Daniel Edward Maloney.

verifiedNonRulingContext.finding: Identifies Daniel E. Maloney in the Sixth Municipal District at Markham, handling preliminary hearings and drug, mental-health and veterans treatment courts.
verifiedNonRulingContext.limit: Assignment information does not identify a particular contested ruling or political position.

verifiedNonRulingContext.finding: Announced a June 3, 2025 Markham treatment-court graduation before Daniel Maloney with five graduates.
verifiedNonRulingContext.limit: A scheduled ceremony and general program description are not proof of any individual case disposition, a signed merits ruling, or political alignment.

profiles.coverageNote: Expanded surname and official-court searches did not establish an attributable merits ruling. This is a retrieval limitation, not evidence that the judge has issued no rulings.
